correctness.rationale: The precise domain is all q-symbol words of length 8 for any finite \(q\ge2\); the full multiset of 36 nonempty contiguous-substring Parikh vectors is used, preserving multiplicities. The four interleavings have equal spectra by the reciprocal-prefix-polynomial identity. Equality of full spectra forces equality of source symbol counts, so every possible q-ary fiber reduces under a common symbol relabeling to one of 22 partitions of 8. The standalone exact checker enumerated 95,503 canonical words, compared full membership of every fiber against reversal/interleaving classes, and found only types (4,4), (4,3,1), and (3,3,1,1) supporting four-member classes. Independent direct q=2,3,4 histograms and all lengths ≤7 confirm boundary cases. Class counts and coding optimum follow by exact combinatorial counting; no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Length 8 is the first blocklength permitting nonreversal ambiguities in the complete-composition reconstruction model. A complete all-alphabet classification and q-polynomial enumeration quantify the entire first-failure structure, determine exact worst-case ambiguity 4 and exact zero-error reconstruction-code capacity, and separate inevitable reversal equivalence from true four-way ambiguity. This is a natural extremal finite cutoff with a free alphabet parameter, not an arbitrary slice or a computational restatement of the original binary collision example.
